load_config_yaml: load a YAML training config file with seed and learning rate overrides into a DotMap
save_pkl_object: save a Python object to a pickle file creating parent directories as needed
load_pkl_object: load a pickled Python object from a file and return it
review_load_config: review the load_config function to understand how YAML configs are parsed with float resolution
test_save_and_load_pkl: test saving and loading a Python object using save_pkl_object and load_pkl_object
